svg.title: Building a ridgeline
svg.desc: The same sixteen profiles drawn as bare lines, with hidden-line removal, and as curtains under the isotop camera.
svg.text: (b) painter's algorithm: back to front, filled
Panel (a) hides nothing; (b) and (c) hide what a nearer ridge covers. In (c) time runs along x (now at the lower right) and rows run from kernel (back) to containers (front).
